User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to see all my assigned VIPs in a paginated table so that I can quickly assess my full book of business at a glance.
Acceptance Criteria: Table loads with all assigned VIPs on page load | Columns visible: Name · Segment · Tier · State · GGR L30 · Last Contact · Last Bonus Issued · Status · Actions | Pagination shows X–Y of N VIPs | Default sorted by Last Contact ascending

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to see a skeleton loading state while VIP data is fetching so that I understand the page is loading and not broken.
Acceptance Criteria: Skeleton rows appear immediately on navigation | Skeleton matches table column structure | Loading resolves within 3 seconds on standard connection

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to see an empty state message when no VIPs are assigned to me so that I understand why the table is blank and what to do next.
Acceptance Criteria: Empty state displays icon + headline + descriptive message | Message directs user to contact manager or check assignment settings | No broken UI or console errors

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want GGR L30 values to be color-coded (green = positive / red = negative) so that I can immediately identify at-risk players without reading every number.
Acceptance Criteria: Positive GGR: green text with + prefix | Negative GGR: red text with − prefix | Color coding consistent across all table rows

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want Last Contact dates to show urgency coloring (dark ≤14d / orange 15–25d / red >25d) so that I can prioritize outreach without manual calculation.
Acceptance Criteria: ≤14 days: dark/default text | 15–25 days: amber/orange text | >25 days: red text | Relative labels used (e.g. 22 days ago)

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to see each VIP's segment abbreviations (SBK · CAS · DFS · FDR) as plain comma-separated text so that I can scan product engagement at a glance.
Acceptance Criteria: Segments display as comma-separated abbreviations e.g. SBK, CAS | No chip or pill components used | Abbreviations match defined taxonomy

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want VIP status (Active / Suspended / Deactivated) displayed as color-coded pill badges so that I can instantly identify non-active players.
Acceptance Criteria: Active: green pill | Suspended: amber/orange pill | Deactivated: gray pill | All pills display uppercase text

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to search for a VIP by name so that I can quickly navigate to a specific player without scrolling the full list.
Acceptance Criteria: Search input appears in the filter bar | Results filter in real-time or on submit | Matching VIPs display; no match shows empty state | Sorted by dismissal pill appears when filter is active

User Story: As a KAM Manager I want to apply SLDS list filters to narrow VIPs by segment / tier / or status so that I can focus on a specific subset for review or reporting.
Acceptance Criteria: Filter button opens SLDS OOTB filter panel | Filters available: Segment · Tier · Status · State | Filtered results update table and pagination count | Filters can be cleared individually or all at once

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to sort the table by GGR L30 descending so that I can prioritize outreach to my highest-value players first.
Acceptance Criteria: Clicking a sortable column header (Name · Tier · GGR L30 · Last Contact · Last Bonus Issued) toggles sort asc/desc | Active sort column shows highlighted header with directional arrow | Row order updates immediately | Sorted by [Column] ↓ dismissal pill appears in filter bar

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to see quick action buttons when I hover over a VIP row so that I can take action without navigating away from the table.
Acceptance Criteria: Hover reveals: filled blue Log Contact button + View underline link + ⋯ overflow menu | Non-hovered rows show muted outline Log Contact only | Hover row: blue-tint background + left accent stroke

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to log a contact directly from the table row so that I can record interactions quickly without opening the full VIP record.
Acceptance Criteria: Log Contact accessible from hover state and bulk action bar | Clicking opens log contact modal or flow | Submission saves to VIP record and updates Last Contact date

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to select a single VIP row and see a contextual bulk action bar so that I can take targeted actions with clear visual confirmation of my selection.
Acceptance Criteria: Checking row checkbox triggers bulk action bar | Bar shows: count badge (1 VIP selected) + Log Contact + Send Bonus + Export + Clear selection | Selected row: blue checkbox + left accent border + blue-tint bg | Header checkbox shows indeterminate state

User Story: As a KAM Manager I want to select multiple VIP rows at once so that I can perform batch actions across several players in one workflow.
Acceptance Criteria: Multiple rows selectable via checkboxes | Bulk bar count updates to reflect selection (e.g. 3 VIPs selected) | All selected rows display consistent selected styling | Clear selection deselects all rows and dismisses bulk bar

User Story: As a KAM Director I want to export selected VIPs to a file so that I can share book-of-business data with stakeholders outside the console.
Acceptance Criteria: Export button in bulk bar triggers download or export flow | Export includes all visible column data for selected rows | File format is CSV or Excel

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to see an amber triangle indicator on a VIP's name when Agentforce has a pending NBA action so that I know to act before my contact window closes.
Acceptance Criteria: Amber triangle SVG renders inline with VIP name for players with pending NBA actions | Triangle absent for players with no pending actions | Indicator visible in default and hover row states

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to click an NBA indicator to see a popover with the Agentforce recommendation so that I can understand the action without leaving the table.
Acceptance Criteria: Click opens floating popover anchored to the indicator | Popover shows: NBA Action Pending header + Agentforce badge + AI recommendation text + View NBA Queue → CTA + Log Contact secondary action | Popover dismissible by clicking outside

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to see bonus information (amount / type / date) in Last Bonus Issued so that I can track recent promotional activity without opening each record.
Acceptance Criteria: Bonus cell shows dollar amount on top line and Type · Date on second line | No bonus issued: — placeholder renders | Data populates from VIP bonus history

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to see an Overbonused badge when a VIP has hit their bonus cap so that I don't accidentally issue a bonus that will be rejected.
Acceptance Criteria: Overbonused badge renders inline in bonus cell with $0 in red | Clicking badge opens detail popover: balance + last bonus + cap reset date + View Bonus History CTA | Overbonused rows: red left accent border + red-tint background

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want Shield Select shown with a shield icon so that I can distinguish top-tier players at a glance without parsing text.
Acceptance Criteria: Shield Select displays small shield SVG icon before label | Tier 1–5 display as plain text only | Shield icon present on both desktop rows and mobile cards

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to access my VIP book of business on mobile so that I can review player status and take quick actions from my phone between meetings.
Acceptance Criteria: Mobile view renders as stacked VIP cards (not horizontal table) | Each card shows: name + NBA indicator + segment + tier + state + GGR L30 + Last Contact + Last Bonus Issued + status pill + Contact button | Cards scrollable vertically

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want VIP cards on mobile to visually communicate urgency signals (Last Contact color / Overbonused / NBA) so that I can triage quickly on a small screen.
Acceptance Criteria: Last Contact uses same urgency color coding as desktop | NBA amber triangle appears on card when pending | Overbonused shown in red on card bonus line

User Story: As a KAM Manager I want to see summary metrics for my team's book of business (Total VIPs / Active / Promotions / Demotions) on the Overview tab so that I can assess portfolio health at a glance.
Acceptance Criteria: Overview tab displays four metric cards: Total VIPs + Active + Promotions + Demotions | Each card shows large count value + trend indicator + label | Color-coded top accents: blue (total) · green (active/promotions) · amber (demotions)

User Story: As a KAM Director I want the Overview tab to include a Tableau Insights section so that I can view embedded analytics without leaving the console.
Acceptance Criteria: Tableau Insights section visible on Overview tab below metrics cards | When not configured: placeholder shows Pending integration badge + Configure Integration CTA | Section is collapsible via Collapse toggle

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want the table to paginate results so that page load stays fast even with a large book of business.
Acceptance Criteria: Pagination shows Showing X–Y of N VIPs | Next and Previous buttons navigate between pages | Page position persists when returning from a VIP record | Default page size is 10 rows
